title: Macos Blackbox Host Setup
content: This machine is a macOS setup for blackbox. Production blackboxd is managed by launchd label `com.daystrom.blackbox` and normally runs `/Users/invidious/.local/bin/blackboxd`; restart with `launchctl kickstart -k gui/$(id -u)/com.daystrom.blackbox` after rebuilding/installing the binary. Config locations have a macOS nuance: Rust `dirs::config_dir()` resolves to `~/Library/Application Support`, so `bro fleet` may read `~/Library/Application Support/blackbox/fleet.json`, while this host also keeps the main `config.toml` and a mirrored `fleet.json` under `~/.config/blackbox/`. Check/update both fleet.json files when changing fleet-local settings unless `BLACKBOX_CONFIG` is explicitly set.
